notes.title: PANIC IN SWEETS LAND Update part 3!
notes.content:
We have updated the game adjustments.
The updates are as follows

1.Restore now succeeds when the enemy's HP is rainbow-colored!
　Restore actions now always succeed when fairies' HP is rainbow-colored.

notes.title: PANIC IN SWEETS LAND Update part 2!
notes.content:
I've updated the game with bug fixes and game tweaks, so check it out!

The folllowing updates have been made.

1. Added Restore Action to Queen Miruru.

2. Adjusted the number of ingredients when making sweets.

3. Added Miruru to the list of characters for Miruru's Heart Pounding Trials.

4. Character movement speeds have been slightly increased.

5. Graphics have been adjusted.

6. Fixed a few bugs.

notes.title: Panic In Sweets Land Update!
notes.content:
Adjusted parts related to battle playability.

The following contents were updated:



1. Shortened the activation time when connecting restore actions with a combo.

It's now easier to use because it activates in half the normal time... maybe?
But the voice dialogue was canceled and it ended up like "Restore Hari Rec!"...
It's probably okay?"



2. You can now get RP even if you defeat fairies with normal attacks.

Even if you defeat them with normal attacks, you'll still get RP, so feel free to smash the fairies.
However, the RP earned will be less than if you successfully restore them.
Sorry, but the RP value in this case won't be displayed....



3. Eliminated the jump backwards after Miruru-sama's dive attack.

Since this jump after The Royal Eagle and Sylphid Strike is gone,
Cueen Miruru is definitely the strongest.



4. Mint's attack power has been slightly increased.

Actually, Mint's melee combos are pretty strong too!



5. Increased the amount of RE recovered from some of Lime and Mint's moves.

RE recovery was severe, so we made the recovery slightly better.
